lines.en: I fly fast over the plains.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一开，全是颜色。
lines.en: My wings open into every color.
I circle the allium bloom.

lines.zh: 我趁日头正高，去访绒球葱。
lines.en: With the sun high, I visit the chives.

lines.zh: 我从一朵花飞到下一朵。
lines.en: From one flower to the next.
I skim the grass tips without a breeze.
I follow the field's edge.

lines.zh: 我的速度快，方向变得也快。
lines.en: Fast, and my turns are faster.
Sun on my wings is dazzling.
I weave through the pollen.
I rise to check the wind.

lines.zh: 我落在叶子正面，晒一晒。
lines.en: I land on a leaf's face to sun.
I just passed over your head.
The most flowers grow at the wood's edge.
My path wanders because I am hunting flowers.
Quick wingbeats, very little sound.

lines.zh: 我合上翅，颜色就藏起来了。
lines.en: Wings closed, my colors hide.
I sun myself on a flower.
The day wind is warm.
I rest a moment, then fly.
Seven colors on my wings.

lines.zh: 绒球葱的蜜很淡，但干净。
lines.en: Allium nectar is thin but clean.
I rest on a chive bloom and groom my wings.
The flowers are busy with insects.
I wait for the sun to shift.

lines.zh: 我停着的时候，像一片花瓣。
lines.en: Resting, I look like a petal.
Butterflies do not sing. We flutter.

lines.zh: 这里的蜜源够我吃几天。
lines.en: Enough nectar here for days.
Admiring my colors?
No net, please.
You stepped on a flower.
I am quicker than your hand.

lines.zh: 你手里的玻璃瓶，我见过。
lines.en: I know that glass jar.
I know every flower on these plains.
Catch me, or watch me?
Catching me by day is hard.
Your shadow falls on the blooms.

lines.zh: 我只在花上停，不在人身上。
lines.en: I land on flowers, not on people.
A small tear in my wing.

lines.zh: 翅尖被碰卷，我飞成一条弧。
lines.en: My wing tip curls and I fly in an arc.
Some of my color came off.
I land on a flower to rest.
It hurts. I can still fly.
I make no sound. Butterflies do not.
Dust scatters in the air.
I crawl two inches along grass.
My wing membrane got crumpled. Can't fly fast.
I hide beneath a petal.
Allium. My favorite.
That bloom has too little nectar.
Not sweets. Nectar only.

lines.zh: 把花插在土里，我才会去。
lines.en: Plant it in soil and I will come.
A picked flower. A shame.
You hold it too high.
The wind carries the scent off.
I feed only on the flower itself.
Set it down and I will approach.
That one I might try.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的翅，颜色都散了。
lines.en: You touched my wing; color scatters.
I tilt and avoid it.

lines.zh: 你的手指擦过我的翅粉。
lines.en: Your finger caught my wing dust.
I am so light you barely felt it.
Do not wave. It throws my course.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我从你帽檐下钻过。
lines.en: You look up and I dart under your hat brim.
The bump cost me some dust.
Back off, then I will land.

lines.zh: 我落在你袖子上，又飞走。
lines.en: I land on your sleeve and leave.
So light. Does that count?
In the flowers, we fly in pairs.
Eggs in rows along the leaf veins.

lines.zh: 我的颜色就是给同伴看的。
lines.en: My colors are for my own kind.
The caterpillar eats leaves only.
The season is brief. Hurry.

lines.zh: 你问这个，翅膀不答应了。
lines.en: My wings object to that question.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此飞，就成了。
lines.en: We circle each other. That is enough.
Tiny eggs, set along the veins.
The next brood will be prettier.
Do not disturb us. Move along.
I sip the dew on the leaf.
A fallen petal. I go around.
Pollen gathers on my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西太亮，我不碰。
lines.en: Too bright. I leave it.
I lift a small petal.
One taste of that sugar, then gone.

lines.zh: 我把卵挪到向阳的叶子。
lines.en: I move eggs to a sunny leaf.
Things on the ground get crushed.
Carrying slows my flight.
You take it. I only look.
The net is up.
I change course and climb.

lines.zh: 我这翅膀上，全是彩虹的色。
lines.en: My wings hold every color of the rainbow.

lines.zh: 网还没落下，我已经升高。
lines.en: The net hasn't fallen and I've already climbed.
I head into the thick flowers.

lines.zh: 翅膀一抖，我就换了位置。
lines.en: One flick and I am elsewhere.
You stand out in the sun.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最近的一朵花。
lines.en: I have the nearest bloom marked.
You stepped on a flower. I saw.
This time I fly first.
I weave among the flowers.
You cannot turn as fast.
My colors flash in the sun.

lines.zh: 我停一下，看你有没有动。
lines.en: I pause and check your move.
The wind lifts me higher.
Your net is at the wrong angle.
Two blocks above your head.
Your eyes will lose me.
I have gone behind you.

lines.zh: 花丛给了我很多藏身处。
lines.en: The blooms give me plenty of cover.
Wing dust lands in your eyes.
I bump your nose.
Barely a blow.
I scratch across your fingers.
Do not grab. I struggle.

lines.zh: 我用翅缘扫过你的耳朵。
lines.en: I brush your ear with the edge of my wing.
You blink, and I am gone.
Just enough to remind you.
I land on your hand and spring off.

lines.zh: 蝴蝶也有翅膀可以拍人。
lines.en: Butterflies can slap with wings.
A bit of color over the blooms.
Day on the plains. I emerge.

lines.zh: 绒球葱开的时候，我就在。
lines.en: When the allium opens, I am there.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很轻的扇动。
lines.en: A very light fluttering.

lines.zh: 我落在一朵花上，第一次。
lines.en: I land on a flower for the first time.
The sun lights my wings.
One more butterfly on the plains.
I rise from under a leaf.
The air smells of pollen.

lines.zh: 我绕着花转了一圈才停。
lines.en: I circle once before landing.

lines.zh: 绒球葱的花，是我的蜜源。
lines.en: Chive blossoms are my nectar.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，翻了翻。
lines.en: I drop from the air, tumbling.
Wet wings and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶子上掀飞了。
lines.en: The shockwave flung me off the leaf.
An arrow clips my wingtip.
Magic dulls my colors.
Without nectar I will not last.

lines.zh: 雷光让我的颜色更艳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning makes my colors flare.
No flowers below. Only void.
